claims.text: Anthropic's merged code changes grew from about 2,500 per day in May 2026 to over 30,000 per day by September 2026.
Anthropic could not replicate a global repository lock on the merge queue at agent scale, and relies on post-merge and pre-deploy automated testing.
A 30-minute merge-group CI run caps a strictly serial merge queue at about 2 PRs per hour.
Graphite's merge queue is stack-aware, landing PR stacks as a unit in dependency order.
